Frequently Asked Questions

If you have more questions, please contact us.

You can think of Read Frog as Anki for the AI era, but it is not just flashcards. Anki is powerful for spaced repetition and deep customization. Read Frog brings AI into everyday reading, videos, web pages, and notes, then helps understand content, create study material, and generate review cards automatically. You learn from daily input with less friction, without the tedious personalized card-making and high setup barrier Anki often requires.

Read Frog is a learning system, not just a browser extension. It also includes a web app that helps you manage study notes and review flashcards. In the future, we will expand to iOS, Android, desktop apps, and even MCP. Our goal is to cover every everyday language input scenario and help you learn without friction.

Today, users can import books into the browser with a third-party EPUB reader, then use our extension to read and learn. Our first-party EPUB reader is also in beta: it is open to selected accounts for now, and uploading books to it is a Pro feature.

Not yet, but this is one of our highest-priority plans and we are actively preparing it.
